verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official CLI. It covers `supabase init`/`supabase start`, runs the full stack locally or in CI, and can be pinned per project via npm. It also exposes agent-relevant features: `supabase db advisors`, a local MCP endpoint at localhost:54321/mcp, telemetry opt-out, and a CLI reference corpus in llms.txt. A community user confirms `supabase start` spins up Docker from migration files, though others report rough local-dev experiences. missing for 10: documented machine-readable (JSON) output or non-interactive agent modes, a broader command reference (deploy/link/type-gen via CLI) in evidence, consistent independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth CLI experience.
